What we handle

You should not have to manage the people we provide.

We take care of hiring, training, coaching, data, and reporting so your Head of Sales can stay focused on the business.

Hiring

We find the right person and handle replacement when it is needed.

Training

We train the rep on the role, your offer, the market, and the conversations they need to have.

Management

We review calls, coach the rep, track the work, and step in when performance slips.

Data support

We keep the rep supplied with the right accounts, contacts, and clean data.

Visibility

You can see what happened, what is changing, and what we think should happen next.

Frequently asked

Service questions

The team should fit your sales motion, not force you into a package.

Can we start with one service and expand later?

Yes. You can start with the sales gap that matters most today and add more support later if the work and results justify it.

Who manages the representatives?

We do. A sales manager coaches the rep and holds the work accountable. Client success and data support stay involved so your team is not left managing the details.

Can Capital Generations work inside our existing tools?

Yes. We can work inside your CRM and workflow where it makes sense. We also use Outreach to run the work and Power BI to make the results visible.

Are services limited to the United States?

Our main focus is B2B sales in the United States. We can also discuss broader coverage when the market and engagement call for it.
